title: Most Start Up Die Because Of This 😱 #shorts #businesstips #entrepreneurship #startup #systemdesign
description:
This Is Why Your Business Is About To Go Broke
Most business owners think they're losing money because of bad marketing or a slow economy. Wrong. They're losing money because everything runs through their head instead of a system.
In this video, you'll see the 4 systems every business needs but almost nobody builds:

Lead Capture — where every form, DM, and call actually goes (hint: it's not your inbox)
Follow-Up — why the average lead needs 5 touches, and most businesses only do 1
Getting Paid — how to stop manually chasing invoices
Delivery — how to hand off work without becoming the bottleneck
If your business can't run without you for a week, you don't own a business. It owns you.
